title: Cold Outreach — AIDA
subtitle: Your cold emails and LinkedIn messages get ignored. You're writing about your product
useWhen: when the prospect hasn't yet agreed that they have a problem. Your outreach sounds like everyone else's.
howToUse: AIDA is one of the oldest marketing frameworks in existence, created by Elias St. Elmo Lewis in 1898. It maps the journey from cold contact to action: Attention (stop the scroll - make them read the first line), Interest (build relevance - make them feel this is about them), Desire (create urgency - make them want the outcome), Action (clear single next step). Most cold outreach fails at Attention. The first line of any message must be so relevant or intriguing that not reading the rest feels like a loss.
steps: Write three variations of your opening line before sending, the best one is rarely the first.
Never start a cold message with your name, company, or what you do.
The Action step should be frictionless, a question, not a calendar link.

Personalise the Attention line for each prospect, generic attention doesn't work. Write messages that get opened, read, and replied to The most expensive STP mistake is targeting the largest segment instead of the most winnable one. A smaller segment where you have a clear advantage will outperform a large segment where you are one of many.
origin: Elias St. Elmo Lewis — AIDA model, 1898
promptBody:
Act as a B2B cold outreach copywriter using the AIDA framework.
My product         :  [WHAT YOU SELL AND THE PROBLEM IT SOLVES]
Target prospect :  [ROLE, INDUSTRY, COMPANY SIZE]
Specific trigger  :  [WHY REACH OUT NOW  news, funding, job change, content they   
                                  posted]
Desired action    :  [ONE THING YOU WANT THEM TO DO]
Write 3 cold outreach messages using AIDA:
ATTENTION      :  First line stops them  specific to them
INTEREST         :  Connects their world to the problem you solve
DESIRE              :  Outcome they want not features you have
ACTION              :  One low-friction next step
Keep each message under 100 words.
Make each variation use a different opening angle.

proTip:
The single biggest improvement to cold outreach response rates is the first sentence.
Write it about them, not about you. Reference something real and specific  a post they
wrote, a company announcement, a problem specific to their industry right now. AI can
research this context - use it.
